subject: Please protect UK funding for tuberculosis programmes
body:
Dear {{mp_name}},

I am writing as your constituent in {{constituency}}.

[PLACEHOLDER — standard letter body to be written]

{{ask}}

Yours sincerely,
ask: I am asking you to urge the UK government to maintain its funding for tuberculosis programmes, including its pledge to the Global Fund.

abstentionist.copy_status: PLACEHOLDER — Leah's Option A draft (see NOTES.md 'Open decisions'), not signed off by TBFighters. Applies to both strings below.
abstentionist.card_note: Your MP is a member of Sinn Féin, whose MPs do not take their seats in the House of Commons. This message asks them to raise TB funding with UK ministers directly.
abstentionist.ask: I am asking you to write to the Foreign Secretary and the Minister for Development urging the UK to maintain its funding for tuberculosis programmes, including its pledge to the Global Fund.
